tools.name: kizeo_list_forms
tools.description: List all forms in the Kizeo Forms account with their ids and names. Good first call to find a form_id. REST: GET /forms.

tools.name: kizeo_get_form
tools.description: Get one form's complete definition: its fields, their types and ids. Use it to read field names before filtering data. REST: GET /forms/{formId}.

tools.name: kizeo_search_form_data
tools.description: List the data records (submissions) of a form, with optional advanced filters and ordering. Pass form_id `all` to search every form. Filter `operator` values are passed to Kizeo unchanged. REST: POST /forms/{formId}/data/advanced.

tools.name: kizeo_get_form_data
tools.description: Get one data record (a submission) of a form, with all its field values and media names. REST: GET /forms/{formId}/data/{dataId}.

tools.name: kizeo_get_unread_data
tools.description: Get the data records of a form that this action has not read yet, up to `limit`. Mark the ones you handled with kizeo_mark_data_read. REST: GET /forms/{formId}/data/unread/{action}/{limit}.

tools.name: kizeo_mark_data_read
tools.description: Mark data records as read for one action, so kizeo_get_unread_data stops returning them for that action. Repeating the call has no further effect. REST: POST /forms/{formId}/markasreadbyaction/{action}.

tools.name: kizeo_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the Kizeo Forms account. The token's user may need administrator rights to see all users. REST: GET /users.

tools.name: kizeo_list_groups
tools.description: List the groups of the Kizeo Forms account. REST: GET /groups.

tools.name: kizeo_list_external_lists
tools.description: List the external lists (reference lists that the mobile forms use) with their ids and names. REST: GET /lists.

tools.name: kizeo_get_external_list
tools.description: Get one external list's definition, including its items. REST: GET /lists/{listId}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kizeo_search_form_data, kizeo_mark_data_read · Private data: kizeo_search_form_data, kizeo_get_form_data, kizeo_get_unread_data, kizeo_mark_data_read, kizeo_list_users · Public sink: kizeo_search_form_data, kizeo_mark_data_read.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kizeo_search_form_data, kizeo_mark_data_read · Private data: kizeo_search_form_data, kizeo_get_form_data, kizeo_get_unread_data, kizeo_mark_data_read, kizeo_list_users · Public sink: kizeo_search_form_data, kizeo_mark_data_read

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
